name: traffic-barrier
description: A raised vehicle barrier boom on an outlined support post.
useCase: Locate a vehicle boom barrier at a parking or site entrance.
misuse: Use ticket-gate for a pedestrian gate with fare readers.

16.reason: The full support counter stays open, and the raised boom starts inside the top stroke without entering the white post opening.

24.reason: The complete raised boom and outlined support stay balanced; the connected cap remains contained in the post top.
